name: Citadel Residential School
description: About Us Citadel Residential School – ‘A castle of knowledge’ located in the midst of a peaceful and natural environment at Ettichuvadu, Ranni is a Co-educational Christian Minority institution managed by the Catholic Diocese of Kanjirapally. ‘Citadel’ a name deeply embedded in the educational map of Southern Kerala was established in 1992. It grew and diversified to meet the changing needs of time and education with the introduction of Higher Secondary classes in 1999. Since its inception, it has evolved into one of the premier and leading institution of Pathanamthitta District imparting quality education It is affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and follows the curriculum of National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT). At Citadel, we join hands towards a better tomorrow, which blossoms from our vision and mission. The school makes every effort to form young generation who will build a more just and humane world. It strives for a scholarly venture that focuses on vital and original thinking, with the aim of societal transformation. The school makes a preferential option for all sections of society and it seeks to give an all round formation, inculcating both human and spiritual values. Proficiency, empathy and dedication are the hallmarks of the human person we seek to encourage. Here learning is done in a congenial environment. Citadel identifies the potentiality in each student, by imparting expert and activity oriented learning. Each child receives an education which is skill based that develops his critical and logical thinking. Each learner is helped to lead an exemplary life, a life enriched with not only wisdom, but also admirable values. The learners are engineered by dynamic people who are fervent instructors of wisdom and knowledge. Citadel is trying to provide realistic all round schooling, with the aspiration of forming girls and boys who will be disciplined citizens and will demonstrate a high academic calibre as well as emotional equilibrium, religious sensitivity and social commitment. Thousands of students have passed through the portals of this institution during the last 25 years and they bring to mind with wistfulness the days spent in this institution, and the precious impact it had on their lives.

description: About Us For Oxford School to be a truly outstanding school with an excellent academic reputation that provides first class care, guidance, support and development so that everyone enjoys a positive experience during their time at the school and leaves well prepared for life beyond it.We achieve this by ensuring: Outstanding teaching and learning across the school A Curriculum that meets the needs of our Students allowing them to progress Students have access to a wide range of enrichment and extra-curricular activities Development of confidence, independence of thought and resilience in our students Regular and effective engagement with stakeholders of the school High quality leadership and management across the school Praise and reward are central features of the school Oxford School is blessed with magnificent infrastructure, separate hostels for Boys and Girls with modern facilities, enthusiastic, highly motivated staff and a sound ethos of social awareness. For all who embrace the many opportunities presented, Oxford School will reward them with a happy, memorable and empowering education. Students here practice values of commitment, sharing and support for one another always. Endowed with such wide range of skills and knowledge, students pass out every year to shine brilliantly in various walks of life as renowned professionals, but above all, AS A COMPLETE PERSON THE OXFORD TENDER CARE Our goal is to provide a safe and caring environment where children can gain a positive approach to school and learning. They will learn to care for, and respect each other, whilst learning how to be part of a group. Good nursery education is crucial to a child’s formative years, and fosters an enthusiasm and confidence that will remain with them throughout their school life. Our experience and dedicated staff and with the support of parents the children become successful learners, confident individuals. Children learn through play and structured lessons with a balance of free choice. IT IS WIDELY ACCEPTED THAT CHILDREN IN THIS AGE GROUP ABSORB AND ACHIEVE MORE THAN ANY OTHER STAGE IN THEIR SCHOOL LIFE, AND THIS MAKES CHOOSING THE RIGHT NURSERY SCHOOL VITAL. WHAT WE OFFER: stimulating indoor and outdoor areas for purposeful learning specialist resources for ICT, gym, art and technology enjoyable, stimulating and challenging activities through structured learning and educational play. WHAT WE DO: Meet the needs of the individual child Deliver all aspects of the Early Year Foundation Stage Curriculum (EYFS) within an enhanced programme of activities Support the transition of each child to the next state of learning Focus on the joy of learning, happiness, self-esteem and confidence

name: Holy Grace Academy
description: About Us Holy Grace Academy is an English medium co-educational CBSE Residential School founded in 2000 with 135 students, 15 staff on roll and has consistently grown into a big family of around 3000 students and 300 staff as on today. The Holy Grace Academy CBSE School imparts international standards by adopting the latest methodologies, implementing innovative measures and ideas. From its inception onwards the School was successful in retaining its reputation as an educational institution with a difference by way of offering a host of features and training programs aimed at improving the academic, social, intellectual and behavioral skills of students. The School offers IIT and IAS foundation courses from Std. VII onwards. A research centre for learning disability also functions at the School. With a view to making education friendly and interesting to the first time school goers, the School has designed a Smart Kindergarten with latest technologies and innovative ideas to match international standards. This is a comprehensive academic schedule for Pre-Kg, LKG and UKG which reduces the burden on children, teachers and parents and makes learning a stimulating and rewarding experience.VISION To build a strong foundation for the all-round development of each student by nurturing the spirit of innovation, passion for learning and value system which could make a difference globally. MISSION Holy Grace accomplishes the dream of transforming a 'Team of Total Quality Students' with positive mindset. Reading habits will be improved and Confidence building activities such as Seminars, Debates, Anchoring by the students will be implemented to explore the creativity, imagination, presentation skills and intellectual audacity of the students. One hour play time for classes [I- VIII] accompanied with activity packed curriculum enhance the soft skills of all children placed under our care. One hour play time for all the classes accompanied with activity packed curriculum enhance the soft skills of all children placed under our care. AIMS & OBJECTIVES To impart education having global standards with innovative practices. To become a path maker for the young generation by rejuvenating the moribund values. The 3 way process in education ie Formation, Information and Transformation to be accomplished. To form "Good Children" not mere "Smart Ones". To transform our children into 'Total Quality Students' (TQS) – so as to cater global requirements. Above all, our stake holders deserve to get back 'Human beings with substance and good character'.

This study gave then 444 quality components of a great school. They also realized that no school has all of them at the same level. While in some schools academics is “great”, in another administrative systems are and yet again in another the infrastructure. And then in 2014, 5 years before the makers of the school envisioned it, the school became one of the Top 10 schools in the country. Over the past 5 years Sadhbhavana World Schools is continuously ranked in all the popular rankings in India in the Top 10 category.

name: Labour India Gurukulam Public School
description: About Us With a dream to provide our students scientific and easier systems to learn Shri George Kulangara started his new endeavour “Labour India Publications” in 1983 at Marangattupilly. Within a short span of time Labour India rose to meteoric heights and attained the status of a peerless institution in educational publication. In the course of time, Labour India progressed from a Private Ltd Company in 1992 to a Public Ltd Company in 1995. Having started with a single magazine in 1983, we now produce nearly 50 specialized educational journals ranging from the primary level to the entrance exam level courses - all to quench the thirst of the student, teacher and parent communities and to win their hearty admiration. As modernization crept, it influenced each and every field. Even the education system was not unfazed by it. Mr. George Kulangara understood the effectiveness of this age-old Gurukulam System. He felt the need of resurrecting this system as he foresaw it as a crucial force in changing the contemporary education system. His idea germinated in the form of “Labour India Gurukulam School”. Here it is an amalgamation of the essence of the Gurukulam system and the modern education methodologies. What evolved from a dream to create a Gurukulam back in the year 1993, has emerged to be one of the premier educational institutions in India on par international standards, with over 750 students from 15 different countries. Labour India Public School & Junior College was founded by Mr. V. J. George Kulangara on 4th June 1993 in his hometown Marangattupilly in Kottayam, Kerala, South India. His Guru (Teacher), the late Prof. K. M. Chandy, former Governor of Madhya Pradesh, India, inaugurated the school. And from then on, there was no looking back. The Gurukulam at Labour India Hills has grown to become a model educational institute, embracing traditional values even as we impart an international educational curriculum.

description: About Us Trivandrum International School (TRINS) is set in a serene, 20-acre eco-friendly campus atop a hill on the outskirts of Trivandrum, the capital city of the State of Kerala, India. The beautifully landscaped campus is a perfect blend of modern amenities and natural surroundings. Convenient road, rail, and air routes make the city well-connected and easily accessible tothe international and domestic community. Wilbur. Every child is unique with a sea of treasure lying underneath, waiting to be discovered, and polished so that it can shine its best. The top-of-the-line boarding infrastructure with spacious rooms, 3 students per room, en suite washroom facility and well-appointed rooms with hot water facility ensures the best stay-in experience for the students. The health of our students stands prior, hence we serve fresh, hygienic and nutritious food prepared by in-house chefs which is out of an extensive food menu which is regularly refreshed from time to time. We assure personalized attention and care for each boarder, from the resident Principal and Teaching staff. The boarders’ weekends are planned with leisure trips to museums, art galleries, cinemas, exhibitions and other performances to give them an experience of the local culture, thus augmenting their communal outlook. Outstation trips to nearby hill stations and cities are planned on long weekends. Thus, TRINS stands arguably the best choice as a residential school for your child in Kerala.

name: Sadhbhavana World School
description: About Us Way back in 2005, when a group of enlightened souls came together with a single vision of bringing on to the soils of India a school that was like no other – unique in concept and approach, Sadhbhavana World School came into being. They realized that every school has three common takeaways – intellectual content, humane content and social content. However, some schools are mediocre, some good and some are great. What is that distinguishing factor that makes schools great? So began their quest – they visited some of the best schools in India and abroad, to research what makes a school great. This study gave then 444 quality components of a great school. They also realized that no school has all of them at the same level. While in some schools academics is “great”, in another administrative systems are and yet again in another the infrastructure. Nevertheless the group decided to strive to make as many as possible in the “great” category at Sadhbhavana and thus the 444 quality components were divided into 10 distinct baskets based on the broad category they belong to. With this wealth of knowledge and a vision to make the school one of the top 10 schools in the country over a period of 10 years, Sadhbhavana World School was established in 2008.Situated on an expansive campus spanning 29 acres, Sadhbhavana World School soon established itself as a unique school in the city of Calicut within a few years itself. And then in 2014, 5 years before the makers of the school envisioned it, the school became one of the Top 10 schools in the country. Over the past 5 years Sadhbhavana World Schools is continuously ranked in all the popular rankings in India in the Top 10 category

description: About Us Small beginnings pave the way for great enterprises. STRS, the fledgling of MTCES, began as a modest venture into the field of academics with just 6 students on 6 June 1966. Today STRS has established itself as a Centre of Excellence, imparting quality education to students and preparing them for the Indian Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (ICSE – Class X) and also for the Indian School Certificate Examination (ISC-Class XII) conducted by the Council for Indian School Certificate Examinations, New Delhi.Within the hallowed precincts of this great institution the students are initiated into the world of knowledge, nurtured and trained to be the best talents in the country, who occupy pride of place in the top most echelons of society. All the top ranking universities and professional colleges have a fair share of the alumni of STRS. Much of the credit for this high standard of scholarship goes to a team of dedicated teachers who impart knowledge with professionalism and commitment and the sharp and keen scholars who pursue knowledge with meticulous thoroughness. Ranked as Kerala’s No.1 Co-Educational Boarding School in the Educational World India School Ranking for two consecutive years, STRS is a name to reckon with in the academic, literary, cultural and Sports fields, assuring the best of holistic education to its students The school is located on a sprawling 30 acre campus in a picturesque locale at Mukkolakkal, A state of the art Computer Lab, modern Tennis and Hockey courts, Skating rink, Stadium and a Chapel to cater to the spiritual well being of the students lend the most congenial ambience for the smooth conduct of the teaching-learning process. The campus has hostels for boys and girls and can accommodate about 350 students in 3 hostels. The sister concerns STCS and STHSS as well as St.Thomas Training College are situated on the same campus, making it the most prestigious centre of learning in Trivandrum city.

name: Mar Thoma Residential School
description: About Us Mar Thoma Residential School was founded in 1974 by the Mar Thoma Educational Agency, Tiruvalla, Kerala, India, which is a charitable body registered under the Travancore-Cochin Literary, Scientific and Charitable Societies Registration Act XII of 1955. The Metropolitan of the Mar Thoma Church is the Patron of the Society. The school started functioning with three teachers and eighteen pupils. From such humble beginning, the school has had a phenomenal growth. At present, it has 83 teachers and over one thousand six hundred pupils on the rollThe school has excellent facilities for ideal residential education. Our class rooms have a manageable strength of 35 students each.The school has the best Library in this part of the State with over 25000 volumes of books and almost all the leading magazines / journals in English, Hindi and Malayalam. The school subscribes to all leading Newspapers in English and Malayalam.The school also has a Junior Library specially for the primary section. Computer Education has been given added impetus with the addition of a new Junior Lab with 10computers in addition to the modern Computer Lab with 35 Computers for Senior classes. Computer awareness programme is incorporated into the curriculum for Classes I to VIII. For Std. IX -XII Computer Science is one of the optional subjects. Computeraided Education is one of the goals to which the school is committed.The school has separate hostels for Boys and Girls, full time Wardens and Ayahs are available to take care of children. Resident Teachers supervise the study hours and other activities of the hostels. Weak students are given special coaching by staff. Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian food is provided in a healthy and hygienic environment. Parents are strictly advised not to bring any food or snacks for the boarders. We have a well equipped Health Care Centre where students can avail the services of a qualified nurse. All boarders regularly attend the Sunday worship at the Jerusalem Mar Thoma Church, Kuttappuzha.Family prayers are held in Hostels. A combined worship service is held on Saturdays in the evening. Sunday School classes are also conducted for boarders.The school also makes arrangements and prepares students for the Service of the First Communicants. Normally, boarders are allowed to go home once in a month on second Saturdays. Children can be visited by parents, guardians or relatives between 3.30 pm and 6.00 pm on week days and between 9.00 am and 6.00 pm on weekends. However, parents and guardians are advised to keep such visits to the minimum. Parents must give a full list of the persons who are authorized to visit the children. Children are not allowed to keep money in any form as well as jewellery or any other valuables. Boarders should bring the following articles all properly marked for easy identification. All pieces of clothing must have the pupils initials stitched in coloured thread. Three copies of the complete list of articles belonging to the pupil will be required at the time of admission, and at the beginning of each year. One to be put on the pupil’s locker, one for the warden and the third for the parent or guardian. All copies will be attested by the wardens in charge of the hostels. All articles must be taken home at the end of the year.

name: Sai Krishna Public School
description: About Us Sai Krishna Public School is a friendly, independent CBSE affiliated centre for excellent education, located in Chenkal, Neyyattinkara taluk, Thiruvananthapuram district, Kerala.The school believes in the great inherent potential in each student and passionately strives to provide a rich and stimulating education to bring out this potential and lead each student to succeed in life. Through high academic standards, the students are nurtured as global citizens and given guidance for a successful future, in a friendly and joyous atmosphere. The school provides individual attention to ensure the progress of each student. Students are encouraged to think originally, have spirit of scientific enquiry, enjoy learning, welcome challenges, take up responsibilities, indulge in creativity, protect the environment, conserve natural resources, respect all people, be ambitious about future and achieve excellence in every field. Students are recognized as individuals with unique talents and skills and are enabled to develop self-confidence and respect towards all. Students become responsible citizens, intellectually independent with enquiring minds and proactive about their capabilities. Every opportunity is given for developing morally, mentally, spiritually, emotionally, socially and culturally. Students also get plenty of opportunities for awareness on the protection of the environment, direct action for a greener earth, and to participate in arts and sports activities. While remaining vibrant and energetic, the students are also trained to be tolerant and respectful of all other people. The school welcomes applications from families wishing to work in close partnership with the school for the brighter future of their children. The Story of Sai Krishna Public School Sai Krishna Public School was established over two decades ago in 1996. Udaya Educational and Charitable Trust, took over the reins in 2008, with only 160 students. The new management improved the infrastructural facilities and amenities to accommodate and train 3000 students. The School now has 1400 students. Sai Krishna Hostels were built with separate accommodation for boys and girls from 5 to 12 standards, whose houses were far away and who could not go home daily. All the school and hostel buildings are equipped with modern amenities in addition to uninterrupted power, water and clean drinking water supply. Security safeguards have been inbuilt and sufficient security personnel have been engaged to ensure the safety of the inmates

name: Stella Maris Boarding School
description: About Us Stella Maris Boarding School, functioning in Koodaranji for the past 22 years, is a distinctive educational institution. The school offers an atmosphere similar to that of hill station schools. It is a recognized institution affiliated with CBSE, functioning from LKG to Class 10. Students from various states across India reside here and provided with quality, contemporary education. The institution gives special emphasis to shaping socially responsible future citizens through both curricular and co-curricular activities. With modern facilities such as high-tech digital classrooms and expert teachers, the school nurtures the diverse talents of students. Specialized training is provided in areas such as Football, Athletics, karate, , skating, badminton drawing, dance and music by experts in each respective field. Students of the institution have been consistently achieving excellent success in CBSE Sahodaya arts and sports competitions. For more than 15 years, the school has proudly maintained a 100% success rate, with students securing higher grades in the Class 10 CBSE board examinations. The campus features a green, eco-friendly environment that promotes biodiversity, a beautiful school ground, and modern facilities including separate air-conditioned hostel accommodations for boys and girls. There is also a grass court for football training. A unique feature of the school is the individual attention and personalized training provided to students who are academically weaker. Following the Gurukula system of education, the management and teachers reside on campus along with the students. The daily operations of the school are led and guided by Chairman Dennis Jose and Vice Chairperson Seena Dennis. Under their leadership, the institution successfully provides high-quality and contemporary education to society. Stella Maris Boarding School nurtures and shapes the interests and aspirations of the new generation by delivering education suited to modern times.

name: Shalom Residential Public School
description: About Us Education liberates, knowledge transforms individuals; and surpasses boundaries. Today our school education system has become somewhat distant from the lives of our children.Shalom is devoted to redefining literacy through innovative strategies in the classroom. Our approach is creativity-oriented and methodology is query-based. Much emphasis is given to value-based and child-oriented education. ‘Holistic Growth’ of a child is the motto of the school. The school curriculum is designed to make learning a joyful activity for children. We believe that the destiny of the tender and young minds is in our hands. The success or failure is largely determined by the school atmosphere. Here at Shalom, we give them two things – the ROOTS and the WINGS. Your quest for a school of your imagination comes true with Shalom Residential Public School (SRPS). Established in 1997, situated in a twelve acre picturesque location at Chittur, Palakkad. Shalom Residential Public School is a co-educational offering both residential and day school facilities. It is affiliated with CBSE (affiliation number is 931065). Shalom has students from ten states and teachers with national and international exposure. A multilinguistic and cross cultural student and teacher community is a commendable feature of the school. The pre-school division of SRPS is branded as ‘Shalom Tots’. Shalom Tots focuses on pre-school, post school and play school for students in the age group of 3½ yrs – 5½ yrs. School conducts coaching for civil service, medical and engineering aspirants of classes VIII onwards. School has a well experienced faculty having expertise in subjects and procedure giving students the essential know-how to excel in all competitive examinations. Shalom hostel has wardens and dorm parents to look after each child in the hostel. The day begins with prayer and jogging at 5.30 am. and ends after evening study at 10.00 pm. Guided study for each child is strictly monitored to ensure his/her performance. Day boarding is also available on request. SRPS is owned and managed by Shalom Charitable Ministries of India (Shalom Trust) a trust registered under Indian Trust Act 1882. Shalom Trust is engaged in Social housing, Sanitation, Health Care and Education.

description: About Us A global citizen places his or her identity with a global community above his or her identity as a citizen of a particular nation or place. Advancement of internet and information technology has brought the world closer than ever and globalization is happening in every fields. To be successful in a globalized economy, students should be prepared to collaborate with people across the globe. We cannot transform our students unless all our staff, parents as well as management undergoes the transformation. Mahatma Gandhi, famously said – “be the change that you want to see in the world”. Within the Carmel family everyone undergoes this transformation. The term you in the mission statement includes students, staff, parents and management. We are all together in this journey of life and at Carmel we strongly believe that in this journey of life we can go further together.

name: The White School International
description: About Us The White School International (TWSI) is a K-12 day-cum-boarding school located in Calicut. It was founded by Mr. P. Sulaiman, the Chairman of HiLITE Group, with the goal of becoming one of the world’s leading schools. TWSI offers students the choice of three syllabi: International Baccalaureate (IB), Edexcel, and CBSE; being the only school in Kerala to do so. As Kerala’s first IB Continuum School, TWSI provides IB education from Nursery to Diploma level. At TWSI, we understand that each student is unique and therefore, a one-size-fits-all approach may not be effective. Each syllabus is designed to empower students through practical, activity-based learning that is tailored to each individual student. Our dedicated faculty is committed to inspiring curiosity and developing skills, values, and achievements in each student. By graduation, our students will be confident and ready to tackle any challenge that comes their way. We believe that learning should not be limited to textbooks and classrooms. At TWSI, students have the opportunity to engage with the world and experience hands-on learning in the real world, providing a well-rounded education. The TWSI community of mentors, students and parents alike are committed to holistic and progressive education that is student centric. Our students’ inquiries and learning needs, their socio-emotional well-being and their holistic growth by way of the ‘head, heart and hands’ underpins all of our offerings. This is supported by a strong culture of collaboration across the school.

name: Kuriakose Elias English Medium School
description: About Us The Kuriakose Elias Group of Educational Institutions were established in the year 1991, situated at the eastern side of the hillock of Mannanam, Kottayam. Mannanam is the Holy place, where St. Kuriakose Elias Chavara started the CMI Congregation and his first Sanskrit school. The schools are named after this great luminary of the 19th century Kerala and managed by the CMI St. Joseph's Province, Thiruvananthapuram. Kuriakose Elias School, was started on July 16, 1991 is an unaided English Medium School, is recognized by the Government of Kerala, with the U P and High School sections. In June 1995, Kindergarten Section and Day Care Center was added to the School. The ICSE syllabus was introduced in the year 2000. The ICSE Board approved the new school and so it got affiliated to the ICSE in February 2002. The ICSE school eventually became permanently affiliated to the ICSE Board, Delhi, with the Higher Secondary Section (ISC). In July 2002, the recognized State Syllabus was upgraded to a Higher Secondary School with courses in Science, Commerce and Computer Science.

name: St Berchmans Higher Secondary School
description: About Us St Berchmans Higher Secondary School is the first school of the Syrian Christians of Kerala. The school was founded in 1891, by Bishop Charles Levinge, the first Bishop of Changanacherry. It was established to impart sound education to students irrespective of caste or creed. It is the unique feature of S B that it was started as residential school. The school is directly owned by the Archdiocese of Changanassery. The school started higher secondary course in 1998-99 with two science batches and one commerce batch. At present we have four science batches and two commerce batches. Ever since its foundation, the school pays careful attention to the comprehensive development of its students. St. Berchmans HSS, Changanassery is the brainchild of the great visionary prelate Rev. Dr Charles Lavigne SJ whose foresight was quite instrumental in launching the Archdiocese in the field of mass instruction. The school, ever since its foundation is keen on imparting holistic schooling to its beneficiaries, irrespective of caste and creed, financial and social backgrounds. The school was upgraded as higher secondary in 1998. Now the higher secondary wing offers value added quality schooling to 600 boys and is one of the largest boys’ higher secondary schools in the state.
